chunks: My father (may God be pleased with him) narrated to me. He said: Abdullah ibn al-Hasan al-Mu'addib narrated to us from Ahmad ibn Ali al-Isfahani from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad. He said: Muhammad ibn Ali al-Sarraf narrated to us. He said: al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan al-Ashqar narrated to us from Ali ibn Hashim from Abu Rafi' from Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr from 'Abbad ibn Abdullah from Salman (may God's mercy be upon him) from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), who said:
The best judge of my community and the most knowledgeable of my community after me is Ali.

key_terms.أعلم: The superlative of 'to know' — the most knowledgeable, the one with the deepest and broadest religious knowledge
key_terms.أقضى: The superlative of 'judge/adjudicate' — meaning the one most skilled in rendering verdicts according to justice and law
key_terms.الأمة: The nation/community of believers, meaning the entire Muslim community (umma)
key_terms.بعدي: After me — indicating temporal succession to the Prophet's authority

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about Imam Ali's knowledge and judgment?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) declared Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib to be the foremost in judicial reasoning and religious knowledge among the entire Muslim community after the Prophet himself. This tradition was transmitted through Salman al-Farisi — the loyal Persian companion deeply devoted to the Ahl al-Bayt — through a long chain reaching Sheikh al-Saduq. The context situates Ali's superiority not merely as administrative leadership but as epistemological authority: he is the ultimate reference for Islamic law and knowledge after the Prophet.

en.bilal-muhammad: My father (ra) narrated to us. He said: `Abdullah b. al-Hasan al-Mu’addab narrated to us from Ahmad b. `Ali al-Isfahani from Ibrahim b. Muhammad. He said: Muhammad b. `Ali al-Sarraf narrated to us. He said: Al-Husayn b. al-Hasan al-Ashqar narrated to us from `Ali b. Hashim from Abi Rafi` from Muhammad b. Abi Bakr from `Abbad b. `Abdullah from Salman (rh) from the Prophet (s). He said:
The best judge of my Nation and the most knowledgeable of my Nation after me is `Ali.
